trials.claim: Lifetime access to WP Reset on Tier 1
trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to WP Reset
- All future Pro Plan updates
- If Plan name changes, deal will be mapped to the new Plan name
trials.reasoning: The exhibits show snapshots can be deleted after 180 days and the vendor offers a 7-day refund, but neither proves or denies lifetime access to WP Reset on Tier 1.

exhibits.quote: All Snapshots not used (downloaded or edited) in over 180 days are automatically deleted.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is undermined because stored snapshots are automatically deleted after 180 days of inactivity.

exhibits.quote: 100% No-Risk Money Back Guarantee! You are fully protected by our 100% Risk-Free Guarantee. If you don’t like the plugin over the next 7 days
exhibits.argument: Vendor advertises only a 7-day refund window on its own site, contradicting a lifetime deal with broad future guarantees.

trials.claim: Tier 3 includes Unlimited Site licenses, 30 WPR cloud site licenses, 3 GB storage per cloud site
trials.claimQuote:
Unlimited Site licenses
- 30 WPR cloud site licenses
- 3 GB Storage per cloud site license
trials.reasoning: The exhibits complain about cloud-storage marketing and snapshot deletion, but do not confirm or contradict Tier 3's unlimited site licenses, 30 cloud licenses, or 3 GB per site.

exhibits.quote: My main issue is with their “Unlimited Cloud Storage” upsell — which is highly misleading and probably illegal.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the unlimited cloud storage marketing is misleading because each site has a hard cap.

exhibits.quote: All Snapshots not used (downloaded or edited) in over 180 days are automatically deleted.
exhibits.argument: Unlimited storage claim is limited by automatic deletion of unused snapshots after 180 days.

trials.claim: Tier 4 includes Unlimited Site licenses, 60 WPR cloud site licenses, 3 GB storage per cloud site
trials.claimQuote:
Unlimited Site licenses
- 60 WPR cloud site licenses
- 3 GB Storage per cloud site license
trials.reasoning: The exhibits mention unlimited site licenses with a 3 GB per-site cap and snapshot deletion, but do not confirm or contradict Tier 4's 60 cloud site licenses.

exhibits.quote: what they’re actually selling is unlimited site licenses, each with a hard 3GB per-site cap.
exhibits.argument: Tier 4 unlimited claim is actually capped at 3GB per site, making large snapshots unusable.

exhibits.quote: All Snapshots not used (downloaded or edited) in over 180 days are automatically deleted.
exhibits.argument: 60 cloud licenses with 3GB each are still subject to deletion after 180 days, undermining unlimited storage.

trials.claim: Tier 1 includes 5 Site licenses, 5 WPR cloud site licenses, 3 GB storage per cloud site
trials.claimQuote:
5 Site licenses
- 5 WPR cloud site licenses
- 3 GB Storage per cloud site license
trials.reasoning: The vendor listing shows 5 site licenses and 5 WPR Cloud Site Licenses matching Tier 1, and the prosecution exhibits do not contradict those quantities or the stated 3 GB cap.

exhibits.quote: One of my WooCommerce site’s snapshots was over 3.5GB, meaning even without buying the upgrade, I could already see it wouldn’t be usable.
exhibits.argument: 3GB per-site cap makes the Tier 1 cloud storage unusable for sites larger than 3GB.

exhibits.quote: All Snapshots not used (downloaded or edited) in over 180 days are automatically deleted.
exhibits.argument: 5 cloud licenses with 3GB each are not permanent storage due to automatic deletion after 180 days.

exhibits.quote: 5 sites license 5 WPR Cloud Site Licenses Over 25 tools Snapshots & Auto Snapshots Plugin & Themes collections
exhibits.argument: Quote shows Team tier includes 5 site licenses and 5 WPR Cloud Site Licenses matching Tier 1 quantities claimed.

trials.claim: All future Pro Plan updates included
trials.claimQuote:
All future Pro Plan updates
- If Plan name changes, deal will be mapped to the new Plan name with all accompanying updates
trials.reasoning: The exhibits discuss price lock-in and the vendor's regular annual pricing, which do not show whether deal buyers receive all future Pro Plan updates.

exhibits.quote: We don’t have any price lock-in guarantees. If you buy for $10 today and see a deal for $5 tomorrow, we won’t refund you $5 nor upgrade your account
exhibits.argument: Vendor disclaims price lock-in and upgrade guarantees, contradicting promise of all future Pro updates being mapped automatically.

exhibits.quote: Agency ## ~~$299~~ $119 /year 100 sites license 50 WPR Cloud Site Licenses

You will recover your sites thanks to the snapshots in seconds.
